summary.en: US equity futures flat to slightly elevated as pre-market AI and semiconductor stocks show selective strength. Fed rate decision probability remains low at 30%, supporting growth stock valuations despite mixed macro signals. Oil holds above $82 on Middle East geopolitical concerns, keeping energy sector under risk premium.
summary.zh: 美股期指早盘平稳至微幅上涨，盘前 AI 和半导体股票表现分化。美联储加息概率保持低位 30%，支撑成长股估值尽管宏观信号混杂。油价维持在 82 美元以上受中东地缘担忧影响，能源板块承受风险溢价。

title.en: Nasdaq Futures Rise 0.3% on AI Chip Demand Optimism
title.zh: 纳斯达克期货因 AI 芯片需求乐观情绪上涨 0.3%

impact.en: Strong demand for AI accelerators from major cloud providers continues to boost semiconductor valuations ahead of earnings season.
impact.zh: 主要云服务商对 AI 加速器的强劲需求持续在 earnings season 前提振半导体估值。

macroRisk.en: AI concentration risk in tech-heavy indices; earnings-driven rally may face headwinds from valuations.
macroRisk.zh: 科技指数中 AI 集中风险；盈利驱动的上涨可能面临估值逆风。

title.en: Oil Near $84 as Middle East Tensions Persist Beyond Ceasefire Deadline
title.zh: 油价接近 84 美元，中东紧张局势在停火截止日期后持续

impact.en: Geopolitical risk premium sustains energy prices despite OPEC+ supply discipline. WTI above $82 signals continued inflation concerns.
impact.zh: 地缘政治风险溢价支撑能源价格尽管 OPEC+ 供应纪律。WTI 高于 82 美元表明持续的通胀担忧。

macroRisk.en: Inflation persistence through energy costs; geopolitical volatility transmits to broader market sentiment.
macroRisk.zh: 通过能源成本持续通胀；地缘政治波动传导至更广泛市场情绪。

title.en: US 10-Year Yield Stabilizes at 4.70% Following Soft Jobs Data
title.zh: 美国 10 年期收益率在疲软就业数据后稳定在 4.70%

impact.en: Rate-sensitive growth stocks benefit from yield stability while bond market absorbs uncertainty around Fed policy timing.
impact.zh: 对利率敏感的成长股从收益率稳定中获益，债券市场吸收美联储政策时机的不确定性。

macroRisk.en: Policy pivot narrative strengthens; yields may rebound if inflation reaccelerates.
macroRisk.zh: 政策转向叙事加强；如果通胀重燃，收益率可能回升。

title.en: Dollar Eases Slightly as Treasury Yields Moderate
title.zh: 美元因美债收益率温和而轻微走弱

impact.en: Lower yields reduce dollar strength pressure on EM assets while maintaining relative stability across currencies.
impact.zh: 较低的收益率减轻了对新兴市场资产的压力，同时保持货币间的相对稳定性。

macroRisk.en: Currency market remains stable amid moderate policy divergence.
macroRisk.zh: 货币市场在温和的政策分化下保持稳定。

title.en: VIX Below 15 Despite Geopolitical Oil Risks
title.zh: VIX 低于 15，尽管存在地缘政治油价风险

impact.en: Low implied volatility indicates complacency but offers limited protection if geopolitical shock hits or oil spikes.
impact.zh: 低隐含波动率表明自满情绪，但如果遭遇地缘政治冲击或油价飙升则提供有限保护。

macroRisk.en: Volatility compression may intensify reversal if geopolitical shock hits or oil spikes suddenly.
macroRisk.zh: 如果遭遇地缘政治冲击或油价突然飙升，波动率压缩可能加剧逆转。

ai.en: Selective strength in AI chip demand continues with NVDA, AMD leading. Cloud provider capex drives sustained sector momentum.
ai.zh: AI 芯片需求的选择性强劲持续，NVDA 和 AMD 领先。云服务商资本支出推动行业持续动量。

semiconductor.en: Memory and AI chip makers benefit from infrastructure buildout. MU Technology rebounds on renewed demand signals.
semiconductor.zh: 内存和 AI 芯片制造商从基础设施建设中受益。美光科技在需求信号恢复后反弹。

bigTech.en: Amazon and Alphabet gain on cloud spending. Valuation focus remains on quality earnings rather than pure growth narrative.
bigTech.zh: 亚马逊和谷歌因云支出而获益。估值焦点保持在优质盈利而非纯粹增长叙事上。

energy.en: WTI above $82 with geopolitical premium. Energy sector maintains elevated prices despite ceasefire deadline passing.
energy.zh: WTI 高于 82 美元具有地缘政治溢价。尽管停火截止日期已过，能源板块仍维持高位价格。

ev.en: Mixed as broader auto/manufacturing macro regime impacts demand. EV sector lags in cyclical downturn conditions.
ev.zh: 分化，更广泛的汽车/制造宏观经济环境影响需求。电动车板块在周期性衰退条件下落后。

market.en: Futures flat to slightly positive: Nasdaq +0.3%, S&P 500 breakeven, Dow near neutral. Growth outperforms value on yield stability.
market.zh: 期指平稳至微幅正面：纳斯达克 +0.3%，标普 500 持平，道指接近中性。收益率稳定时成长股优于价值股。

preciousMetals.en: Gold near $4,400 with dollar easing and inflation hedging demand providing support despite lower yields.
preciousMetals.zh: 黄金接近 4,400 美元，美元走弱和通胀对冲需求提供支撑尽管收益率较低。

oil.en: WTI $82-84 range. Middle East conflict risk premium sustains prices above recession zone. Oil volatility moderates after geopolitical shock.
oil.zh: WTI 在 82-84 美元区间。中东冲突风险溢价使油价维持在高点之上。地缘政治冲击后油价波动缓和。

futures.en: Nasdaq futures +0.3%, S&P 500 flat, Dow near neutral. Nasdaq outperforms on AI-driven growth momentum.
futures.zh: 纳斯达克期货 +0.3%，标普 500 持平，道指接近中性。AI 驱动的增长动量使纳斯达克表现更优。

treasury10Y.en: U.S. 10-year yield at 4.70%, stable following soft data and falling rate hike odds.
treasury10Y.zh: 美国 10 年期收益率在 4.70%，数据疲软和加息概率下降后稳定。

dxy.en: Dollar index eased 0.15% as yields stabilize and safe-haven flows moderate.
dxy.zh: 美元指数下跌 0.15%，收益率稳定和安全避风资产流动缓和。

oil.en: WTI above $82, Brent near $89. Middle East tensions prevent collapse despite ceasefire expiration.
oil.zh: WTI 高于 82 美元，布伦特接近 89 美元。尽管停火过期，中东紧张局势阻止了价格崩溃。

keyRisk.en: AI concentration in Nasdaq; oil volatility if geopolitical shocks hit; VIX under 15 offers thin protection.
keyRisk.zh: 纳斯达克中 AI 集中；如果地缘政治冲击发生，油价波动；VIX 低于 15 提供微薄保护。

note.en: Growth rally led by AI sector diverges from cyclical laggards. Risk sentiment cautious but yields and oil stability provide buffer.
note.zh: AI 板块引领的增长行情与周期性滞后的公司分化。风险情绪谨慎，但收益率和油价稳定提供缓冲。
